FN-GG45C6C-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 51
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Bobby Singleton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/14/2025
Senate Bill 51 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Public Education Employees'
Health Insurance Board and State Employees' Insurance Board by an estimated $2.5 million and
$5.3 million annually, respectively, due to the minimum rate set for health insurers to pay the
out-of-network ground ambulance providers in this bill.
Page 1

FN-2LNDISS-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 51
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Bobby Singleton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/10/2025
Senate Bill 51 as reported by the Committee on Banking and Insurance could increase the
obligations of the Public Education Employees' Health Insurance Board by an estimated $1.9
million annually and the State Employees' Insurance Board by an estimated $1.6 million due to
the minimum reimbursement rate set by this bill for health insurers to pay in-network and
out-of-network ground ambulance providers.
Further, this bill would increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of Public Health by
an undetermined amount to adopt rules and obtain annual reports from emergency medical
service providers due to the provisions of this bill.
